evidence.quotation: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster in your GY; add it to your hand.
evidence.historicalApplicability: Current reference semantics; original North American RDS-EN045 printing date independently reviewed as 2004-12-01, not inferred from API dates. Historical printed wording remains pending.

evidence.quotation: You can select a card discarded by the effect of "Monster Reincarnation" as a target of the effect of that same "Monster Reincarnation" (returning the monster to your hand).
evidence.historicalApplicability: Goat Individual Card FAQ. Its loose phrase "by the effect" does not change discard from cost into an effect; current official text supplies cost semantics. Only target selection is borrowed, not adjacent Night Assailant/Makyura trigger rulings.

evidence.quotation: 自分の墓地にモンスターが存在しない場合、このカードは発動できません。
evidence.historicalApplicability: Current official OCG supplement (displayed date 2017-06-03): cannot activate if no monster is in own Graveyard. Not represented as original 2005 TCG wording or an archival Goat primary ruling. No modern Extra Deck or discard-trigger rules are enabled.

notes: Own open Main, hand/own Set. Requires an eligible own Graveyard monster BEFORE paying; discard one other hand card as activation cost, then target an own Graveyard monster, including the just-discarded monster. Return to hand only after two passes, not Special Summon. Normal/effect monsters supported by current registry only; no Extra Deck returns, discard triggers, Necrovalley/replacements, immunity, modifiers or general mixed Chain. Imported historical status stays pending.
